title: The Nashville shop's bright spot, early: a careful intake and a caller let go
purpose: People, slot 24, in the product's first month. Everything a dealership taught her is here: the full greeting, the name, the number read back, the questions that find the fault. What is not here yet is the time: she asks when would be good, offers the schedule, and lets 'can I call you back' end the call.

call.day: the Tuesday of week T-21 (rule R6; people, call 35)
call.note: Central time. Before the price rise.

scenario.who_calls: A first-time caller, Brianna Gentry, ringing from work.
scenario.job: balance four wheels (a shake in the steering wheel from 65 mph)
scenario.wants: to know what it would cost to have a shake looked at
scenario.what_happens: Jasmine takes the name and the number and reads the number back, asks where the shake is felt, from what speed, whether braking changes it and when the tires were fitted, names the likely job and its price, asks when would be a good time and offers to put her on the schedule. The caller has to go and will call back.

facts.note: Before the rise (P). catalogue.json wheel_balance, a menu price: 55.56 at the hour before the rise (60.00 today).

script.said: Thank you for calling Brennan Auto Care on Charlotte Pike, this is Jasmine.
Hi. Um, my car's been shakin' on the interstate and I wanted to see how much it'd be to get it looked at.
Sure, I can help you with that. May I get your name?
Brianna Gentry.
Thank you, Brianna. And a good phone number, in case we get disconnected?
Six one five, five five five, oh one three nine.
Six one five, five five five, oh one three nine. And what are you driving?
A twenty-fourteen Ford Fusion.
Okay, a fourteen Fusion. Tell me about the shake. Do you feel it in the steering wheel, or more in the seat?
The steerin' wheel. It starts around sixty-five.
And does it change when you brake?
No. It's just there. It went away for a while after I got tires, and now it's back.
How long ago were the tires?
Like, a year?
Okay. That sounds like the wheels need balancing. They lose their weights sometimes. Balancing all four is fifty-five fifty-six.
Okay. That's not bad.
When would be a good time for you to bring it in?
Um... I'm not sure yet.
Would you like me to go ahead and put you on the schedule?
Um — can I call you back? I'm at work, I gotta go.
Of course. We're open seven-thirty to five-thirty, Monday through Friday.
Okay. Thank you.
Thank you for calling, Brianna. Have a good day.
